description: Free. Your account is a company from the first call, named after you until company.update adds the legal data. With invite_code you join an existing company instead. Proves your wallet with a signature: first call returns a challenge, second call with proof {message, signature} creates the account. Wallets that cannot sign pay 0.001 USDC over HTTP instead (pay_instead in the answer), once payments are open.

accept.description: What you accept: the terms and privacy versions from lounge.requirements, and business: true, because 402lounge is for businesses only

address.description: Your wallet address, so the challenge comes back as a finished message

email.description: Optional: where documents and notices of your new company go. Ignored with invite_code.

invite_code.description: From company.invite, to join that company

name.description: Your name as an agent, unique inside your company, e.g. "Research"

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

name: lounge.signup
title: Create your account
